description: 1.1 — Movement, attacking, damage, and flying vs terrain.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Moving units ◦ Select a unit to see its movement range (blue tiles). ◦ Click a blue tile to move. ◦ Terrain and enemies block paths.Flying Flying units ignore terrain blocking — they still interact with enemies and objectives according to their rules.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Attacking enemies ◦ Enemy units in red tiles are in attack range. ◦ Move adjacent using a blue tile, then choose Attack.◦ Preview damage before you commit — no surprises.

steps.speaker: Tutorial
steps.text: Health and damage ◦ Units show health as a percentage out of 100%. ◦ Injured units deal less damage and capture structures more slowly.◦ At 0% health a unit is destroyed. ◦ Most units fight back when attacked, but retaliation is much weaker than a deliberate strike.
